argument: 17-magic-items.qmd:380 breaks the DR law the rest of the book was rebuilt around. Adamantine Plate is typed as worn hero armour, yet its passive prints a flat DR 7. Since the #516/#517 ruling no gear may supply a hero's reduction: the shipped source is the Iron Skin talent on its 2/5/8 ladder (09-talents-abilities.qmd:59-63), and both the armour and equipment chapters say the same thing (16-armor-shields.qmd:23, 15-equipment.qmd:221). The number also breaches the DR invariant in the row that actually applies at the item's own rarity. Very Rare finds are placed at levels 7-10 (17-magic-items.qmd:535-537), and Challenge 3-6 opponents still swing the Adept row there (a Challenge 3 Knight's longsword is 6/9/12, 20-bestiary.qmd:132). Against 6/9/12 a 7-point reduction sits above the row's Weak value of 6, so a Weak hit is annihilated by the minimum-damage floor and Standard and Strong compress to 2 and 5. The same item's second passive halves physical damage of the three mundane kinds from creatures up to Large, which pushes the row to 1/1/2 when reduction runs first and 1/1/1 when the halving runs first, and the book never fixes that order (16-armor-shields.qmd:21, 13-combat.qmd:154). Expected value: armour contributes DR 0 for heroes, and a 7-point subtraction belongs nowhere on a wearable card. Fix: strip the item DR; if a defensive perk is wanted, route it through the sanctioned tier-downgrade channel or a talent-style card.

evidence.claim: The Very Rare entry is typed as worn armour and carries a flat DR 7 as a passive, with a second passive that halves non-magical bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage from creatures no larger than Large.
The armour chapter states that a hero's reduction comes from training, not from what they wear, and that a landed hit still costs at least 1.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: from talents such as Iron Skin, not from your armor

evidence.claim: The equipment chapter repeats the same rule for worn armour, so two canonical chapters agree that gear does not add this number.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: comes from your talents and abilities, not from your armor

evidence.claim: The sanctioned heroic source, Iron Skin, tops out at DR 8 on its Master rung, so the legitimate ceiling for this number is 8 and it lives on a talent card rather than an object.
The chapter's own placement guidance puts Very Rare finds at levels 7-10, so the plate is expected to see play while Adept-row attacks are still common.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Levels 7-10: Mostly Rare, one Very Rare for the party

evidence.claim: A Challenge 3 Knight attacks on the Adept row and a Challenge 6 Archmage mixes the Novice and Adept rows, so 6/9/12 is a routine incoming band at the levels this item appears.

Worked check of the invariant: reduction only gives 1/2/5 against 6/9/12 because the Weak value of 6 falls to the floor; reducing before halving gives 1/1/2; halving before reducing gives 1/1/1. Under every ordering the bottom of the row stops being distinguishable, and no passage in the book states whether resistance precedes the subtraction.
